name: Azeroth Companion
title: Visual Build Architect — Independent A/B Scenarios
features: Two temporary side-by-side A/B planning scenarios seeded from live or locally saved matching-specialization builds, or blank.
Official node IDs, rank limits, selected rank tooltip details and source-reported links on per-scenario skill inspectors.
Non-destructive rank editing in both scenarios with true comparison of allocated points and saved choice indices.
Guided structural and source-link advisory review, never an unsupported talent eligibility or performance verdict.
Copyable comparison summary, with no writing to existing user saves and no modification to local recovery state.
Existing Blizzard Worker, existing icon media, source Studio, Talent Command, and PC/iPhone UI remain intact.
